services.name: 60-minute session at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 60-minute session at Alex's home with Gabe. A card is saved and charged $179 when Gabe texts DONE.

services.name: Session at home (3-session pack)
services.story: A 3-session pack at home, $450 ($150 a session), paid in full when booking. Each session uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services_shape: one athlete's time: a session with a named coach, booked by the coach's free hours, at the gym, at the client's home or yard, or on a field the business lists; a partner session adds a second athlete
questions_before_times: new or returning (a new athlete gets the skills check first, and the waiver)
the sport and the skill: hitting, throwing, shooting, dribbling or footwork
where: the gym, at home or the yard, or a field
a single session, a pack or a weekly plan
for a child: the age, and a parent or guardian to book
one athlete or two (a partner session)
safety_stop: a child who isn't breathing or won't wake up right now
a head hit with confusion, a seizure, heatstroke, or a broken bone right now
someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or sudden weakness
a child who says someone is hurting them, or is in danger right now
license: none checked by Rosie: private coaching needs no state license here; a license, certificate or insurance is optional and the business's own word (D96)
staff_skills: baseball, soccer and basketball skills; youth (ages 8 to 17) only with coaches the owner clears for them
messages_never: health answers, injuries, a doctor's note, a child's details beyond the first name and the time, and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the athlete's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
